question: What alternative measure is permitted for the width of the plank?
premises: The verse introduces an alternative with athavā.
The subject is the width of the plank.
The width may be equal to the kuṃbhakarṇa measure.
inference: As an alternative, the plank width may be made equal to the kuṃbhakarṇa measure.
uncertainties: The precise technical value of kuṃbhakarṇa as a measure is not specified here.
plain_english: Or the width of the plank may be equal to the kuṃbhakarṇa measure.
